children: is declared one of the most heavily shorted names in the market, although bearish bets eased in mid-August.

As of Aug. 14, short positions represented 41% of the company's float, involving 56.29 million shares. That figure was 4.3% below the level recorded on July 31. At prevailing trading volumes, short sellers would need an estimated 6.21 days to cover their positions.

Investor positioning also shifted during the second quarter. Uber Technologies expanded its stake by about 24.04 million shares, while BlackRock, UBS Group, State Street and Geode Capital Management also increased their holdings. Bank of America added about 1.32 million shares.

Norges Bank moved in the opposite direction, disposing of nearly 1.29 million shares. Separately, Quiver recorded two open-market insider sales totaling 2,000 shares over the past six months, with no insider purchases.

Analyst targets show a wide range of views. Four analysts have issued targets during the period, with a median of $13. Citigroup and Cantor Fitzgerald have targets of $14, while TD Cowen's stands at $7.
LCID stock fell about 7% on Wednesday.

title: What's Going On With Lucid Group Stock?
